name: Sustain-A-Prompt
tagline: Estimates a prompt's energy, CO2 and water footprint and rewrites it to use fewer tokens.
problem: Generative AI is energy-intensive and users cannot see the impact of their prompts.
solution: Analyses a prompt's footprint at scale with relatable equivalents, optimises it and shows token savings side by side, model-aware.
demo_moment: Team-described: paste a prompt and see its footprint shrink after optimisation.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH - Best use of Auth0” among 85 submissions.
Uses everyday equivalents to make the numbers meaningful.

lessons: Translate abstract units into everyday equivalents.
